sections.brief: Olympic Games/Stuxnet (Sanger) and Flame (WaPo); the 2010-2012 scientist killings, named, with US denials and Israel's non-denial; the Syria campaign (Eisenkot); the January 2018 archive theft; Fakhrizadeh's killing by remote-operated gun (NYT) and the reported motive kept attributed; Natanz July 2020 and April 2021; Isfahan drones 2023; delay vs prevention. Figures: time

Iran's side: Delhi/Tbilisi/Bangkok 2012 (Thai court verdict, Indian warrants, Iran's denial), Burgas and the AMIA ruling (links to hz4), the 2019-2021 shipping war both ways (WSJ, Helios Ray, Mercer Street), the April 2020 water-system and May 2020 port cyberattacks, detentions and the September 2023 swap. Figures: compare (documented vs reported, both sides)

2024 in the open: Damascus consulate strike 1 April, True Promise 13-14 April with US/UK/France/Jordan interception, Israel's 19 April Isfahan strike, Haniyeh's killing 31 July and Katz's December admission, True Promise 2 on 1 October, Days of Repentance 26 October, THAAD; each side's stated position. Figures: stats
